oneOf.description: Array of solution contents for list endpoint

result.description: Solution content data, can be single object or array

count.description: Total count of records (only for list endpoint)

page.description: Current page number (only for list endpoint)

limit.description: Number of items per page (only for list endpoint)

solution_id.description: Unique identifier of the solution content

solution_slug_id.description: URL-friendly slug in Indonesian for solution content

solution_slug_en.description: URL-friendly slug in English for solution content

solution_slug_cn.description: URL-friendly slug in Chinese for solution content

solution_image.description: URL of the solution content's main image

solution_image_tags.description: Alt text or tags for the solution content image

solution_published_at.description: When the solution content was published

solution_category_name_id.description: Category name in Indonesian for solution content

solution_category_name_en.description: Category name in English for solution content

solution_category_name_cn.description: Category name in Chinese for solution content

created_at.description: When the solution content was created

created_by.description: User who created the solution content for solution content

updated_at.description: When the solution content was last updated for solution content

updated_by.description: User who last updated the solution content for solution content

deleted_at.description: When the solution content was deleted (null if not deleted) for solution content

deleted_by.description: User who deleted the solution content (null if not deleted) for solution content
